description: Kubernetes microservices on Google Kubernetes Engine exchanging messages through Pub/Sub with ingress through Cloud Load Balancing or Apigee-style API management expectations. Document service identity (Workload Identity), observability (Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, trace correlation), and private connectivity to Cloud SQL or AlloyDB where relational state is required.
constraints: East-west service calls must use TLS — no cleartext on the cluster network.
No more than four domain services in the first delivery increment unless explicitly approved.
Pub/Sub subscriptions must define dead-letter topics and replay procedures.
requiredCapabilities: GKE cluster with autoscaling node pools and workload identity
Cloud Pub/Sub for async integration between bounded contexts
Cloud Load Balancing or API management layer for north-south traffic
Cloud SQL or AlloyDB for authoritative relational state where required
assumptions: Teams own bounded contexts with independent release cadence.
Shared VPC or host project patterns align to organizational landing zone guardrails.
topologyHints: Prefer outbox or transactional inbox patterns when bridging database commits and Pub/Sub publication.
Separate ingress controllers from internal-only admin APIs.
securityBaselineHints: Binary Authorization or equivalent image signing where supply-chain policy requires it.
Private Service Connect or authorized networks for managed data stores.
